value.title: Woman of the Morning Mist
value.synopsis: Ladies man Oreldo helps a desperate woman come to terms with her past.

value.title: Pumpkin and Scissors
value.synopsis: The meaning behind the Pumpkin Scissors' title is finally revealed as Stecchin explains its creation to Randel.

value.title: Quiet Movement
value.synopsis: Alice is kidnapped by a group of people who want her to reveal the military's secrets.

value.title: The Unseen Pain
value.synopsis: Alice agrees to cooperate with her kidnappers and is released; little do they know what someone has in store for them.

value.title: Rough, but Delicious
value.synopsis: Martis meets with a foreign princess.

value.title: The Flame Still Burns
value.synopsis: Pumpkin Scissors must deal with drug dealers while moving homeless people from the sewers.

value.title: The Decision to Stray
value.synopsis: Pumpkin Scissors continues to fight the drug dealers, and their situation is complicated by a person with a flamethrower.

value.title: The One Who Tears to Pieces
value.synopsis: Alice must unleash her special weapon to finish the fight against the drug dealers.

value.title: The Yet Unrescued Darkness
value.synopsis: Alice fights the Claymores while Randel fights Hans.

value.title: Small War Potential
value.synopsis: Stecchin attempts to cheer up Randel, who has been depressed since the last mission.

value.title: Trick in Treat
value.synopsis: Alice goes to a ball with her sisters while the rest of Pumpkin Scissors gives rations out to the homeless.

value.title: Enter the Performers
value.synopsis: The ball is invaded by an angry mob.

value.title: The Puppet and the Idol
value.synopsis: Marquis sends his two bodyguards at Alice when she challenges him to a duel.

value.title: The Isolated Scales
value.synopsis: Alice must deal with the mob and her opponents, and Randel again looks for a reason to fight.

value.title: And Then There Was a Sweet Trap
value.synopsis: Everyone witnesses Alice's duel, and the military prepares to raid the mansion.

value.title: Soldiers, Commoners, Nobles
value.synopsis: Pumpkin Scissors is quickly running out of time to find a solution before the mansion is attacked.
